title: Latest changing fact wins
description: An intact bridge becomes collapsed in Generation-owned Story Memory before the terminal Plan Next anchor.

story.storyIdea: Alice must continue through the river district.
story.sequenceContext: A grounded journey through the city after a storm.

generations.scenePlan: Alice crosses the intact pedestrian bridge at dawn.
Alice continues through the river district.
A storm breaks the old pedestrian bridge behind Alice.
Alice searches a side street for an alternate route.
Alice follows the river wall through heavy rain.
Alice reaches the blocked river crossing after the storm.

next.instruction: Continue naturally from the blocked crossing.
